lines.text: That’s right! Eevee has the potential to evolve\nin a variety of different ways!
It doesn’t look like your Eevee has any interest\nin evolving, though!
Don’t you think this machine looks rather like a\nwashing machine? It’s not, though!

Augh! What’ve I done?! I accidentally wrote
on the board with permanent marker!\c
Maybe...I could turn it the other way and no one
would ever know?
Urghhh! I’m so busy! Never a moment to breathe!\nCertainly no time to be talking to children!

There’s an email on the screen of the PC...\c
“Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres are all
legendary bird Pokémon. This we know.\c
“Yet their exact whereabouts are still unknown.
We will be investigating the Cerulean Cave next
and will report back accordingly.
       — The Pokémon Research Team”
